notes: When each episode goes public: on YouTube, on the wiki and as a GitHub release. Episodes premiere in order, one per weekday (0 = Monday) at `time` local time, starting with `first_episode` on `first_date`. Dates in `skip_dates` (YYYY-MM-DD) are skipped and push later episodes back a day. `overrides` pins one episode to a moment: {"C01-E005": "2026-10-17 18:00"}. Each episode's YouTube Short goes public `short_delay_days` after the episode, at `short_time` local time.
